# Scansion-LM

A Hugging Face causal language model that writes **original sung lines** for Suno Custom Mode. Fine-tuned from `distilgpt2` on original lyric extracts (never copyrighted hit lyrics). The app wraps those lines in MasterofSFL's metatag sandwich — Italian tempo, genre percentages, `[Start]`/`[End]`, blank-line breath.

## Intended use

- Continue a `Title` / `Idea` / `Verse:` (or `Chorus:` / `Bridge:`) prompt into English lyric lines with `AutoModelForCausalLM`.
- Extract meter / rhyme / section DNA from **original** lyrics you own.
- Retrain on those extracts so the pocket stays yours.

**Not** for cloning a specific artist's lyrics. Hit DNA in Scansion is structural (form, production, meter) — the training text is original.

## Architecture

| | |
|---|---|
| Base | `distilgpt2` (`GPT2LMHeadModel`) SFT on original lyric verses |
| Size | 6 layers, 768-d, 12 heads, context 1024 (train window 256) |
| Tokenizer | GPT-2 BPE (`AutoTokenizer`), pad = eos, vocab 50257 |
| Weights | `model.safetensors` |
| Load | `AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained` / `AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained` — no custom `auto_map` |

Actual `vocab_size`, parameter count, and train loss are written into the **Checkpoint** section of the exported card after training.

## Prompt format

The model is trained to continue lyric blocks:

```
Title: Heat Line
Idea: A man scraping survival out of desert heat, stubborn will over panic.
Verse:
He scrapes at the basin for a mouthful of shade
The highway keeps humming a colorless note
...
```

Same header with `Chorus:` or `Bridge:` for those sections. Inference samples with `temperature=0.85`, `top_p=0.92`. The Scansion app then encodes the lines into a Suno sheet (style field + lyric metatags). Style strings are not generated by the LM — they are the guide's structured encoding of genre %, BPM, and Italian feel.

## Workflow

```text
01 extract   original lyrics → feet, rhyme, sections, energy
02 tokenize  GPT-2 BPE (Hugging Face AutoTokenizer)
03 train     distilgpt2 last-4-layer SFT on CPU, AdamW + cosine, completion-only loss
04 eval      guide checks on LM-written sheets
05 export    Hugging Face folder (safetensors + tokenizer + card + LICENSE)
06 serve     loopback inference sidecar
```

```bash
PYTHONPATH=foundry python3 -m scansion_lm extract
PYTHONPATH=foundry python3 -m scansion_lm tokenize
PYTHONPATH=foundry python3 -m scansion_lm train
PYTHONPATH=foundry python3 -m scansion_lm eval
PYTHONPATH=foundry python3 -m scansion_lm export
PYTHONPATH=foundry python3 -m scansion_lm serve
```

Or the numbered scripts in `foundry/scripts/`.

## Dataset

- Seed extracts generated from original theme packs (desert, night, country, quiet, club, rap, soul, folk).
- Optional user extracts in `data/user_extracts.jsonl` — **your** lyrics only.
- Hit catalog is metadata (BPM, form, production language). **No Billboard lyric text.**

## Limitations

- 82M-parameter model. It writes in the pocket of its original extracts; it is not a large lyricist.
- English-centric BPE.
- CPU-trained last-four transformer blocks.

## Checkpoint

- architecture: `['GPT2LMHeadModel']`
- vocab_size: `50257`
- n_positions: `1024`
- n_layer / n_embd / n_head: `6 / 768 / 12`
- parameters: `81912576`
- steps: `300/300`
- train loss (avg): `1.7386088371276855`
- examples: `640`

Load with vanilla Transformers — no custom `auto_map`:

```python
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("scansion-lm")
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("scansion-lm")
prompt = """Title: Heat Line
Idea: A man scraping survival out of desert heat, stubborn will over panic.
Verse:
"""
ids = tok(prompt, return_tensors="pt")
out = model.generate(**ids, max_new_tokens=80, do_sample=True, temperature=0.85,
                    pad_token_id=tok.pad_token_id, eos_token_id=tok.eos_token_id)
print(tok.decode(out[0], skip_special_tokens=False))
```

Upload:

```bash
huggingface-cli upload ./export scansion-lm --repo-type model
```
